note: The fixed question set for measuring AI answer visibility. Its value is that it does not change: a result is only meaningful next to the same question asked last month. Add questions freely, but do not reword or delete an existing one; retire it with "retired": true so the history stays readable. Questions are drawn from the sector vocabulary in src/data/verticals.ts, because that is the client's own procurement language and therefore the language a buyer's question actually arrives in.
